verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Gumloop acting as an MCP client: it can connect to any MCP server, proxy external servers, and host custom MCP server code that users write themselves. Nothing documents exposing Gumloop workflows, agents, or connected app actions as MCP tools for an external agent to call. Hosted MCPs are custom code deployed on Gumloop's infrastructure, a developer building block rather than this capability. The probe's 'official MCP server' label points to the client-side connection page, so it does not count as support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can expose my workflows or connected app actions as MCP tools that an external agent can call
